preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Close the enemy-combat and product-shell gaps by isolating fixed-spawn reset from checkpoint restoration, exposing deterministic ordinary-run encounter and shell-transition receipts, and repairing the verified 200% safe-area layout defect without replacing preserved map, weapon, actor, or UI families.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate already contains the preserved 18-actor 3/5/10 roster, distinct reservations, enemy presentation bindings, and the previously verified mouse/weapon behavior, but the required uninterrupted encounter matrix was never collected after the candidate-scoped collector disconnected. A concrete control-path defect also makes the restart input invoke checkpoint restoration after checkpoint commit, so the fixed-spawn smoke changes meaning. On the shell surface, existing pages, focus setup, results, and settings are present, but fixed-offset layouts combined with font-only accessibility scaling clip critical HUD copy at 1280×720 and 200%, while transition telemetry is too coarse to qualify the remaining keyboard/mouse, gamepad, pause, settings, recovery, and result states.

stop_conditions: Stop if clean boot, resource loading, the intact authored arena, the stable 18-actor allocation, or preserved mouse/weapon behavior regresses.
If a stateful runtime command loses its receipt after dispatch, record the outcome as unknown and require GameLoop Runtime reconciliation before replaying that scenario.
If the candidate-scoped collector remains unavailable, deliver only the candidate repair and focused self-validation; do not fabricate runtime, screenshot, or issue-closure evidence.
Do not absorb deferred bomb-finale, animation, combat-feedback, lighting, performance, or industrial-density work into these tasks.
Do not modify run-owned evidence, reports, imported source packages, or authored-map child meshes.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy from prior encounter tuning: isolate the two restart semantics, retain the accepted actor/map implementation, and add bounded state-transition receipts that let Tester qualify a single ordinary A→B→C run. On the adjacent shell surface, repair the proven responsive-layout defect and make every required page transition auditable through the same state contract.

code: Run the frozen clean-boot check and reject any parser, resource-load, signal-binding, or runtime error introduced by the focused changes.
Inspect the input dispatch contract to confirm fixed-spawn reset cannot call checkpoint restoration and shell checkpoint actions cannot silently fall back to deployment reset.
Confirm roster and mission snapshots preserve 18 unique IDs, 3/5/10 allocation, route-pressure minima, ordered activation, and atomic 18-actor restore receipts.
Confirm shell/HUD snapshots expose bounded transition, focus, pause, input, result, scale, and layout predicates without displaying diagnostic data in normal UI.

At 1280×720 and 200% scale, capture title/loadout/briefing, gameplay opening story plus objective band, pause/settings, ordinary-death recovery, and both result pages with focus state visible.

Compare the gameplay HUD hierarchy against the attached directional reference: minimap, countdown/compass, feed, objective band, vitals, and weapon state remain separated, readable, and inside safe margins.

Confirm pause/settings/results preserve world readability and grounded transparent styling, with no clipped copy, opaque subtitle slab, default-font fallback, reticle obstruction, or viewmodel overlap.

The roster retains 18 stable identities allocated 3/5/10, distinct route slots, the required route-pressure subsets, collision separation, and accepted presentation bindings.

Ordinary Alpha→Bravo→Charlie activation exposes ordered receipts containing region, actor ID, role, action, target visibility, route target, navigation velocity, nearest-neighbour distance, ammo, health, and shot-event state.
Enemy shot, reload, hurt, death, restore, and meaningful-motion watchdog states remain causally observable without adding a player-facing diagnostic overlay.
The project parses and reaches the existing title screen with no new Godot errors.
